postHoc4NgL.note: The protocol scored the 4 ng/L crossing day against the ORACLE curve. After the first run that reference proved invalid: a symmetric curve fitted to all data puts PFOS above 4 ng/L at day 0, while the samples stay below 4 ng/L until day 14. The comparison was therefore replaced, after seeing results, by a check against the observed sampling interval (last sample below 4 ng/L, first sample at or above), only where the crossing was still in the future at the cut-off. early = forecast on or before the last sample below; late = after the first sample above.
